// CASE js_module_const_param_shadow expect=pass
const width = 1;
export async function runParam(items, width) {
  await mapLimit(items, width, save);
}
// CASE js_inner_let_shadow expect=pass
async function innerLet(items, config) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  {
    let width = config.width;
    await mapLimit(items, width, save);
  }
}
// CASE js_for_of_shadow expect=pass
async function forOfShadow(plans) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  await Promise.all(plans.map(async (plan) => {
    for (const width of plan.widths) {
      void width;
    }
  }));
  for (const { items, width } of plans) {
    await mapLimit(items, width, save);
  }
}
// CASE js_destructured_param_shadow expect=pass
async function destructuredParam(groups) {
  const limit = 1;
  const first = await db.find({ limit });
  await Promise.all(groups.map(({ items, limit }) => mapLimit(items, limit, save)));
  return first;
}
// CASE js_catch_shadow expect=pass
async function catchShadow(items) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  try {
    await risky();
  } catch (width) {
    await mapLimit(items, width, save);
  }
}
// CASE js_function_decl_param_shadow expect=pass
async function outerDecl(items) {
  const width = 1;
  await probe(width);
  async function inner(width) {
    return mapLimit(items, width, save);
  }
  await inner(4);
}
// CASE js_var_hoist_shadow expect=pass
const concurrency = 1;
async function hoisted(items) {
  var concurrency = 4;
  return mapLimit(items, concurrency, save);
}
// CASE js_class_method_param_shadow expect=pass
const limit2 = 1;
class Importer {
  async run(items, limit2) {
    return mapLimit(items, limit2, save);
  }
}
// CASE js_options_shorthand_param_shadow expect=pass
const concurrency3 = 1;
async function optionsParam(items, concurrency3) {
  await mapLimit(items, save, { concurrency: concurrency3 });
}
// CASE js_options_destructured_default_shadow expect=pass
const concurrency4 = 1;
export async function importAll(items, { concurrency4 = 4 } = {}) {
  await mapLimit(items, save, { concurrency: concurrency4 });
}
// CASE js_control_const_fire expect=fire
async function control(items) {
  const width = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, width, save);
}
